all_paragraphs.paragraph: The total number of humans as of July 13, 2025 is 8,226,524,140. And most of them live in Asia with the most populous countries being India and China. The rapid growth of population in this region began from the 1950s. As a result, now 5 places in the top 10 are occupied by Asian countries.
